## 2. Why this directory holds no copy of the source

A second byte-identical copy of a frozen normative document is a second authority that can drift. The snapshot's role — immutable evidence of the input — is served by the pinned digest, which any reader can re-verify in one command: `sha256sum Red-on-Rust.md`. The full S0 artifact set (identity, structural measures, and the cross-checks against `reg/` and `spec/10` pins) renders to `build/spec/source.sha256`, `build/spec/snapshot.json` and `build/spec/source-snapshot.md`.
